about: Owner fills `models` before `plan` / `run` to see a real dollar estimate: USD per million tokens, copied from the provider's official pricing page on the date in checked_on. While a model's price is null, `plan` and `run` show tokens AND an upper-bound dollar figure computed from `fallback` below. No prompt caching or batch discount is assumed.

fallback.about: CONSERVATIVE UPPER BOUND, NOT AN OFFICIAL PRICE. Deliberately high per-million-token prices used only to show a worst-case dollar figure before the owner fills `models`; the owner may override. The estimate also assumes 300 output tokens per reply.
